Correction factor for a Cheysson display font's undersized metrics

Source: R/theme.R
cheysson_font_size_adjust.Rd

The four non-body Cheysson font families (CheyssonSansCaps, CheyssonTitle, CheyssonItalic, CheyssonOutlineCaps) each measure smaller than a typical sans font (Arial) at the same nominal point size - a common trait of hand-drawn/all-caps/decorative designs, which have less ascender/descender space filling out the type's em box. Sizes for text set in one of these families are scaled up by this factor so they read at roughly the intended visual size, rather than shrinking further on top of an already-undersized glyph. Factors were derived from systemfonts::font_info() (max_ascend, lineheight vs Arial at size 11), landing between the ascent-ratio-implied and lineheight-ratio-implied corrections for each family; CheyssonSansCaps and CheyssonTitle were additionally checked against rendered comparisons (see dev/fonts/test_title_size_fix.R).

Usage

cheysson_font_size_adjust(family)

Arguments

family

A font family name.

Value

A numeric scaling factor (1 if family isn't one of the four known undersized display fonts).
